svg.title: Trunk and Shadow: Knotwork board
svg.desc: Trunk and Shadow (1D): the festival board, five columns by eight rows, whose paths are interlaced bands: a piece may move only where a band runs. Four lime Folk climb from the Root row toward the Crown while the dark two-by-two Shadow comes down; one Folk rests safe on a knot square, and the squares another can reach glow. Rule cards sit on the left, Captain Burr waits as the opponent on the right, and the round counter stands at seven of sixteen.
